hypothesis: Extra fields, dependency resolution changes, ambiguous metadata or unsafe Git paths can be hidden by version masking and obtain lightweight.
strongest_guards: Immutable exact B->H, B ancestor H, exactly six modified regular paths, only proven strict quoted spans masked, whole remainder byte-identical, uniform strictly increasing versions, preserved changelog suffix.
evidence: Complete static trace plus independent thirteen ci::cases and twenty-six actual current-layout CLI cases.
disposition: No reachable bypass survives; unsupported layouts return full.

hypothesis: PR-head code/manifests/cached compiler output or stale/misattributed PR metadata can authorize reduction.
strongest_guards: Exact current event/API repo ID and name/B/H/main/principal/ref/label agreement; only immutable protected B checkouts supply build cwd/manifests/lock/helper, separate H Git fetch, isolated target, no persisted credentials or publish/proposal secrets; unavailable/incompatible helper produces fresh full.
evidence: Static actual workflow path plus executed identity/decision positive and failure bodies with exact Git/cargo argv and protected-B cwd checks.
disposition: No confirmed source defect; actual hosted principal/provenance/scheduling remains rollout qualification.

hypothesis: Missing, malformed, failed/cancelled mode or job results, unjustified heavy skips, or stale full/light PR identity can make stable required green.
strongest_guards: Exact eight keys, schema and run/repo/B/H identity, five common successes, full three heavy successes or positive light three exact skips, final current API read for both PR modes plus light trust/main, main push full-only.
evidence: Complete static jq/Bash trace; executed full/light actual bodies, current-identity/API negatives; independent twelve extracted-body cases incl every missing key and main full positive/light rejection.
disposition: No reachable green bypass survives; final read is not a merge transaction, existing server freshness remains required.

hypothesis: Consumer wiring or policy relocation skips mandatory checks or expands retention/trigger/release authority.
scope: main.rs policy integration, ci.yml jobs, docs/release.md CI section
strongest_guards: Single common policy lane, explicit full-only existing heavy jobs, exact required needs and always, same source-sha/native matrix/retention predicate, exact approved bases/activity set, main-only pushes and release unchanged.
evidence: Actual diff plus typed policy mutation tests, ordinary release-gate/check-workflows execution, byte-identical baseline retention body, untouched native/release dependency snapshots.
disposition: No confirmed introduced defect; PR-editable YAML is explicitly not claimed platform-tamper-proof.

scope: closed independent verifier report/result/files, raw logs and JUnit
strongest_guards: All 349 closed manifest sizes/hashes checked; four source hashes match reviewer snapshot, genuine nextest UUID/case inventory and zero fail/error/skip/retry, actual command workdir/profile/env/logs; 26+12 supplements counted separately; no ingestion against old canonical source.
evidence: Reviewer independent artifact readback and XML/manifest verification, no rerun.
